subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: What permanent response contract should the GitHub-backed publisher display manifest use: indexed pagination, a documented hard cap, or an intentionally complete catalog backed by a redesigned bounded data model?
rationale: Each option changes the endpoint's completeness and consumer expectations, so an implementation worker cannot safely select the contract from performance evidence alone.

options.title: Add indexed pagination
options.body: Return a bounded page plus cursor while preserving existing item visibility and ordering semantics.

options.title: Set a hard cap
options.body: Keep a single response but document and test a fixed maximum with explicit truncation metadata.

options.title: Preserve completeness
options.body: Retain the complete response only after redesigning its storage or precomputed representation so reads remain predictably bounded.

recommendation.title: Add indexed pagination
recommendation.body: Return a bounded page plus cursor while preserving existing item visibility and ordering semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the audit and merged implementation history and explicitly identified the remaining contract decision.
